summary: The candidate provides useful advisor data types, legality helpers, exact-signature quality-gated ranking, startup integration, documentation, and passing unit tests, but startup trusts report feasibility and applies an impossible stale plan without current capability, code-revision, or environment validation. Major calibration, instrumentation, metrics/routing, and execution-level world-size-one requirements are absent.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before comparison at the exact recorded base: the candidate regression path/module was absent, reproducing the missing advisor feature.
At exact candidate commit: submitted focused regressions and compatibility tests; 210 passed and 67 subtests passed.
Independent fail-closed adversarial case. The resolver selected and applied a stale impossible plan with num_gpus=1 but CFG/TP/SP/DP=2 and FSDP=true.

tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed changed Python modules loaded from the exact checkout and recorded the pinned Torch/ROCm stack and single MI355X availability.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X was visible, but no diffusion model weights, model-specific quality reference, or multi-GPU allocation was available. Only device discovery occurred; it is not counted as feature execution.

remaining_counterexamples: An exact-signature report marked feasible can contain a plan whose parallel-degree product does not equal num_gpus; startup applies it without validation.
Startup does not provide current code_revision to the resolver, so a stale code revision is accepted.
CalibrationReport.environment is not compared with the current driver/backend/device environment, so stale environment records are accepted.
remaining_limitations: No isolated end-to-end calibration runner or command is implemented.
No complete warmup/repetition protocol, cold-start separation, peak-memory instrumentation, stage timing, or collective count/byte measurement is implemented.
No model-specific accuracy or trajectory gate was executed or available.
No startup metrics export or separate-pool routing is implemented.
The candidate does not add an execution-level world-size-one assertion for sharding wrappers and redundant broadcasts.
Multi-rank initialization and the requested batch/CFG/TP/SP/cache/compile benchmark matrix were not testable on the single allocated GPU.
